entries.title: Quick Launch, Profile Banners & Social Improvements
body: Headline Features
- Added title bar quick launch, letting you pin up to 3 games and access 2 recently played games directly from the title bar
- Added Settings controls to enable or disable quick launch and manage pinned games
- Added profile banners that display an image behind your name in the chat header and Friends sidebar
- Added Settings and Details page options to control whether your game activity is visible in Socials
Socials & Messaging
- Added toast notifications for new group chat invites
- The Store segmented control for All Games and Collections now uses the same design and animation as other segmented controls
- Refactored the emoji and GIF picker layout with clearer header and body sections
- Added a clear button to the emoji and GIF picker search inputs for quickly resetting search terms
- Updated pinned message animations and selection states
- Opening pinned messages while search filters are active now closes pinned messages, and vice versa
- Fixed the alignment of the search filter box with pinned messages
- Fixed the close button alignment in pinned messages
- Fixed a bug where favouriting GIFs in chat stopped working
Performance & Rendering
- Added Chromium command line switches to prevent renderer backgrounding, improving responsiveness when switching between applications
- Added focus-return quiet window logic to suppress animations during focus transitions
- Updated CSS with isolation and transform properties for smoother rendering and layout performance
- Refactored sidebar rendering to reduce visual disruptions during chat interactions
- Added a helper to detect when the app window is active, reducing unnecessary work while in the background
- Optimized profile data fetching by requesting specific fields instead of wildcard selection across multiple components
- Adjusted polling intervals for incoming messages and notifications to lower resource usage while keeping notifications reliable
Bug Fixes & Quality of Life
- Reimplemented scrolling for long announcements
- Updated the App ID in main.js to match package.json build.appId so pinned taskbar shortcuts group correctly with the running window on Windows
- Fixed additional DOM flash issues, although some may still remain

entries.title: Breeze Client Major Update
body: Headline Features
- Nexus Launcher has been renamed to Breeze Client
- The Friends page has been fully revamped and is now called Socials
- Added group chats, allowing multiple people to talk together in a single conversation
- Added Profiles, replacing Account with a redesigned profile experience that lets you view and customize your profile
- Added feature suggestions and bug reports for games and Breeze Client
- Game suggestions and bug reports can be accessed from the Details page
- Breeze Client suggestions and bug reports can be accessed from the sidebar
- The sidebar can now be collapsed
- Replaced the old Windows default title bar with a custom title bar
- Moved Settings from the old sidebar button to a new button on the right side of the title bar
- Settings now open in a brand-new floating settings menu
Socials, Profiles & Messaging
- Added group chat support in Socials
- Added global notification toggles for DMs, group chats, and requests in Settings
- Message notification settings for individual people and groups have been changed to mute settings
- You can now choose how long a person or group should be muted
- Added message reactions
- Added an Undo button for message deletion
- Added embedded previews for links in Socials
- You can now favourite GIFs sent in chat
- Added profile pictures next to names in places such as comments and Socials
- You can now click a person's name or profile picture to view their Profile
- Added number badges to the Socials navigation bar to make DM, group, and request activity easier to see
- Added toast message notifications, an inbox in the bell icon, and optional Windows notifications for new friend requests
- Added number badges for messages on the taskbar icon
- Added a warning toast when a display name has not been saved from the Details page or friends-related areas
- Fixed several DOM flash issues in Socials, although some issues may still remain
- Fixed several scroll issues in Socials, although some issues may still remain
Emoji, GIF & Picker Improvements
- Emoji and GIF picker resize dimensions are now saved when resizing ends
- Reopening the same picker in the same chat now restores the previously saved width and height before positioning
- Picker sizes now reset to their default dimensions when switching to a different friend or chat
- Navigating away from a chat and returning now clears saved picker sizes correctly, preventing resized pickers from carrying over between conversations
Downloads & Game Management
- Downloads can now be switched to queued download mode, which downloads and installs one game at a time
- Downloads can now be reordered while queued download mode is enabled
- Download progress can now be cancelled from the Details page
- Game updates now show progress like regular downloads and no longer open Downloads automatically
- Added a new Downloads and Installs number indicator in the sidebar
- Game installs are now only considered valid when the executable exists and the install path is inside the current install root
- Added Open Game Install Folder to the Details page
- You can now create and remove desktop shortcuts for games from the Library right-click context menu and from the Details page
- You can now pin favourite games to the system tray icon
- Recently played games now appear in the system tray icon right-click menu
- System tray game pinning and recently played settings can be customized in Settings
- Reset Playtime now overrides cloud playtime
- Added a Play button in the Store
- Added a Play option to the Library right-click context menu
- You can now hover over the Running button to exit the game
- Added a GitHub repository button for all games on the Details page
Library, Store & Collections
- Revamped the top navigation for both the Store and Library pages
- The Store and Library now have a larger search bar, compact icon buttons, and a new filter button
- Added new Store and Library filters such as Most Played, Newly Added, and Latest Updated
- The Store category filter has been moved into the new filter menu
- The top navigation buttons and search for both the Library and Store now stay visible while scrolling
- Added a New badge to Store games released within the last 7 days
- Added a new Update All icon button in the Library
- Updated the Library Play button to use the same gradient style as the Play and Install buttons
- Removed the game card translate animation and replaced it with a new scale animation
- Library game card buttons are now larger and have updated visuals
- Collections now has a search bar
- Collections game cards now include the same download progress and logic as Store page cards
- External apps in the Library now show Time Used, Last Opened, and Run instead of Playtime, Last Played, and Play
Details Page
- Added a new horizontal button layout in Details for easier access
- Added Singleplayer and Multiplayer tags, similar to input support tags
- Added info icons with tooltips for Download Size and Installed Size
- Improved the visibility of the engine badge in the Store and Details pages
- Improved the visibility of the back button in the Details page
- Video media in Details now displays better at 150% DPI on 1920x1080 displays
User Interface & Visual Improvements
- Updated UI modals and animations across the app
- Sidebar buttons now use a gradient look similar to the Play and Install buttons
- Updated the design of the number indicators in the sidebar
- Added number badges to the Socials navigation bar
- Updated the design of dropdowns
- Added a brand-new tooltip system for several UI elements
- Media items now scale up when hovered instead of translating
- Changed several button animations from translate animations to scale animations
- Added delete animations and new open and close animations for replies and edits in comments
- Added fade-in animation for the external apps window
- Added the Google icon to Sign in with Google
- Added a new title design for all changelogs
- Changed the changelog Close button to an X icon
- Added a 6-column grid option in Settings
- Added a secret message in Settings
Authentication, Analytics & Legal
- Added Forgot Password
- Analytics now show personal stats such as average playtime and most played game
- All rights are now reserved to Devanand Asai
Backend & Data Improvements
- Refactored changelog formatting for multiple games to use structured body arrays
- Fixed migration issues from older versions
Bug Fixes
- Fixed the auto-update icon in the Library right-click context menu
- Fixed an issue where the friends list did not update when a message was sent
- Fixed an issue where announcement content could shift when another announcement was expanded
- Fixed a misaligned intersecting line on the Friends page
- Fixed the missing divider line at the top of Collections
- Fixed missing fade-in animation when opening the external apps window
- Fixed locked game interactions and several related issues
- Fixed a bug that could cause the friends message notifier to stop working
- Fixed scrolling in Announcements
- Fixed migration problems from older versions

entries.title: Hotfix
body: Headline Features and Fixes
- Added a brand-new download progress bar to both the Store and Details pages, making it easier to track download percentage and cancel downloads directly
- Redesigned toast notifications with a cleaner look and more detailed messaging

- Fixed a major issue that prevented profile pictures from displaying correctly. If your profile picture still does not appear for other users immediately, re-adding it may be required to refresh it for everyone
- You can now favourite GIFs for quicker access later
- The GIF and emoji picker window can now be resized
Friends & UI Improvements
- The Friend List button no longer shrinks when clicked
- Added a grey hover state to the developer pill arrows and removed the transform animation from developer pills
- Updated the chat header to show your friend's @username and improved the overall layout
- Removed the translate animation from some buttons in Friends for a more consistent feel
- The current chat now remains open when switching to Pending
Quality of Life
- After uninstalling a game, you now remain on the Details page instead of being taken away from it
Backend Improvements
- The website link used by the Website button can now be updated remotely via GitHub
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the Downloads list and Recents did not update properly when installing a large number of games at the same time
- Fixed the JavaScript error when opening announcements
- Fixed a visual issue where hovered media items could appear cut off
- Fixed the shadow underneath the hero image
- Fixed an issue where you could open a Details page for external games your friends were playing, even though those games do not have a Details page
- Fixed an issue where changing your display name in Comments or Friends did not update correctly in the Accounts section
- Fixed UI issues at 150% DPI on 1920x1080 displays
- Fixed a bug where the Store page would snap back to the top after installing a game
- Fixed an issue where the "No pending requests" empty state would replay its entrance animation after returning from another window
- Fixed forced auto-scrolling in Friends, although some minor inconsistencies may still remain
- Fixed the time format in Friends
- Fixed an issue that could cause the Friend List order to behave inconsistently, though a few minor inconsistencies may still remain

entries.title: Major Update
body: Headline Features
Brand-New Authentication System
Added a completely new account system with support for Google sign-in and launcher account registration. Your account now syncs important data across the launcher, including:
- Comments you've made
- Friends
- Game playtime
- Profile pictures
External Apps Support
- You can now add External Apps directly through the Library page, making it easier to keep all your games and applications in one place
Friends System Overhaul
- The Friends system has been significantly improved and now uses an account-based system, replacing the old friend code system
- Added new messaging and social features including:
- Hyperlink support in messages
- GIF and emoji buttons
- Message editing
- Message replies
- Right-click context menu for message actions
- Message notifications
- Settings to control who can send you notifications, or disable them globally
Faster and Smarter Details Page
- The Details page now loads significantly faster
- Offline support has been improved so more launcher content remains useful even without an internet connection
Double-Click Shortcuts
- Added a new shortcut: double-clicking a game card will now:
- Launch the game if it is installed
- Download the game if it is not installed
Social & Account Features
- Added support for profile pictures
- Game playtime now syncs to your account
- Names can now include apostrophes
- Removed character limits for comments
- Added dislikes to comments
- Pressing Enter now sends text in both Comments and Friends
- Friends are now sorted by activity
Library, Store & Game Management
- The Library now automatically detects and validates Store games in the install folder
- Added an Update All button
- Added Open Folder for the install folder in Settings
- You can now save a game's cover art or hero art, which can be used when offline
- Games now display badges in the Store, Collections, and Details page showing which game engine they were made in
- Improved locked game logic
- Improved the right-click context menu in the Library by showing the game name and adding shortcuts for:
- Auto Update
- Uninstall
User Interface & Visual Improvements
- Offline mode now shows better information across the launcher, including the Store and Details pages
- Changed the colour of the Unlock All Games and Uninstall All Games buttons to red
- Added a subtle animation when expanding a reply
- Added a highlight colour and upward transform animation for games inside Recents in Downloads
- Removed input support icons from the Details page
- Total disk space used is now shown in Settings
Notifications & Messaging
- Added message notifications for Friends
- Added notification settings so you can choose who can notify you, or disable notifications completely
Bug Fixes
- Fixed stutters on the Friends page
- Fixed an issue where the Downloads list and Recents did not update properly when installing many games simultaneously
- Fixed the category filter scrollbar in the Store
- Fixed screen flashing when opening Nexus Launcher with the Store page set as default

entries.title: Hotfix
body: - Friends chat now updates in realtime
- Changed the design of the delete messege button
- Fixed an issue that caused the button in the friends page that allows you to check the details page for games your friends are playing to stop working

entries.title: Hotfix
body: - Updated and refined the Friends page UI for better clarity and usability
- Fixed an issue where parts of the UI were slightly misaligned at 150% DPI scaling
- Improved the carousel transition animation for smoother visual flow
- Minor stability improvements and visual polish

entries.title: Major Update
body: Headline Features
- Added Collections: browse games by category, view videos, and see recently added games
- Added a Friends page: send/receive friend requests, message friends, and view what they’re currently playing
- Video support has been added to the launcher
- Added "Date added" to the Details page
- You can now reply to comments
User Interface & Visuals
- The announcement panel now supports long posts by allowing you to scroll within each announcement
- The Library page now shows a clearer hint: "Hold and drag a game to rearrange your Library, Right-click on a game to open context menu"
- Improved visual spacing and readability for announcements
- Announcements and Changelogs now render bullet points as proper list items
- Improved animation and styling for dropdowns in both Comments and Analytics
- Added a highlight colour change for buttons on the Details page
- Removed hover transform animations for specific buttons on the Details page and Analytics
- Added a new "Back to top" button for easier navigation
- The Play button now switches to "Running" while a game is active
- Toast notifications now use a more opaque background for improved readability
Functionality & Navigation
- Clicking a game in the Recent History panel now takes you directly to the Details page
- Added a controller indicator to the Details page when gamepads are connected
- Games can now be locked in the Library, preventing them from being moved until unlocked
- Launcher changelogs can now be viewed in Settings
- Category filters have been added to the Store page
- Added an "Updates available" filter to the Library page
- Developer names now appear on game cards in the Store
Preferences & Saved Sorting
- Your dropdown preference for sorting New or Top comments is now saved
- Your dropdown preference for sorting the Top 5, 10, or 20 devs in Analytics is now saved
Cleanup & Polish
- Removed the obsolete Developers section from Analytics
- Removed the full stop from most of the toast notification
Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug that caused the Details page to open automatically after a game finished installing
- Fixed an issue where the Details page could begin installing even after the game had already finished installing

entries.title: Major Update
body: Overview
- The UI has been revamped with better animations and a nicer look and feel
- Bug fixes and performance improvements
- Added a new analytics tab where users can view detailed statistics about the games devs released and a rankings section to see top performers
- Added a new announcements section to keep users informed about the latest news and updates
- You can view recent updates or installs in the downloads page
- The dev pills in store page now works as a horizontal scroll, making it easier to browse through them
